title: Health and last sign-in on Merchants
problem: Health was visible one store at a time, so nobody saw which stores were slipping away.
now: The list shows each store's health and last sign-in, sorts by them, has an At risk view, and the dashboard counts at-risk stores.
steps: Open All merchants and look at the Health and Last sign-in columns (right after Status)
Press the At risk tab: it opens sorted by health
Filter by an account manager to see their at-risk stores
On the Dashboard, open the At risk row in the Merchants card or the at-risk row under Needs someone today
notes: Where: Super admin: Merchants › All merchants (/admin/merchants?view=risk) · Dashboard
